owned_invariants: A refused move changes no state.
An admitted CUT never raises D (section) or Phi_1 (claims).
RETRACT restores the exact recorded snapshot.
boundaries: Moves arrive only through contracts.to_move with admitted values.

score.level_basis: The protocol state machine: four moves, fourteen verdict statuses, refusal without state change, snapshot history and retraction, with one handler per move.

basis.G1: AuthorityEffect: None and a unique URN; complete provenance envelope for the ported logic (pfp_lab/core/PROVENANCE.md: source path, git blob, committed SHA-256, last commit, a table of every change); the differential test maps every verdict field back to the unmodified source. Not A: no signed receipt of the source.
basis.G2: Exact profile: every number in a verdict is recomputed from Fractions; refused moves leave section, claims and history unchanged (tested); behaviour agrees with the Paper 005 oracle verdict by verdict. Not A: no formal model of the state machine.
basis.G3: Every expected failure is a typed exception with a stable code (AdmissionError, BudgetExceededError, UnknownPackError) or a typed verdict; no assert in production code (Ruff S101, AST test) and the whole suite passes under python -O; no bare or broad except (Ruff BLE001/E722). Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
basis.G4: Unit and boundary tests for every branch, negative tests for each refusal, run under pytest and under python -O. Every status has a test; Hypothesis checks monotone descent for both CUT kinds; differential test. Mutation R = 1/1 (see mutation_accounting).
basis.G5: Functions are single-purpose; complexity measured per function. Metrics: worst function: cyclomatic 8, cognitive 9, nesting 2; metrics ceiling A+.
